verdict: Lead cost rose sharply this week; audience and pipeline fixes are underway.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 109 leads at an average cost of $7.55 per lead, but the final week of that window showed a sharp drop — leads fell 47% and cost per lead rose 79% compared to the prior week. The most likely cause is that over half of your ad budget ($424 of $823) has been concentrated in retargeting, and that existing audience is showing signs of exhaustion without enough new prospecting to refill it. At the same time, your Google Business Profile went quiet from August 31 onward, removing an organic source that had been averaging roughly 8 actions per day. Budget is being rebalanced toward prospecting to bring in fresh audiences, and the Business Profile activity gap is being addressed. Expect lead volume to stabilise as the audience pool is replenished over the coming week.

watch_item.issue: Lead volume dropped 47% in the past 7 days as the retargeting audience shows signs of depletion, driving cost per lead up 79%.
